# IContentLoader

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Content` · interface

```csharp
public interface IContentLoader
```

Non-generic content loader entry point. See `IContentLoader<TContent>` for the threading contract.

## Methods

### LoadAsync

```csharp
Task<Object> LoadAsync(string contentKey)
```

Loads the content with a key.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `contentKey` | The content's key: its path under `Content/`, with no extension. |
